name: Satellite autonomy ops
story: A 9-person spacecraft autonomy startup with 5 contracts; its onboard software and camera modules fly on 44 customer satellites, from a 4-cubesat swarm to GEO servicers. Onboard object detections, conjunctions, avoidance maneuvers and navigation health from Mar 2025 to Oct 2026. Fully synthetic.

columns.name: autonomous_ca_enabled_date
columns.description: Date the customer let spacecraft decide collision avoidance onboard; null if never

columns.name: license_per_satellite_usd
columns.description: Yearly software license per satellite, USD

columns.name: hardware_passthrough_usd
columns.description: Cameras and modules resold at cost, USD (no margin)

columns.name: data_sharing_agreement
columns.description: Customer shares onboard data back for model tuning and space traffic intelligence

tables.name: dim_spacecraft
tables.description: One row per customer spacecraft carrying the autonomy software or module.

columns.name: orbit_class
columns.description: SSO dawn-dusk, SSO midday, LEO 53 deg or GEO

columns.name: sensor
columns.description: Onboard sensor used for detection: HDR camera, ST-100 or ST-200 star tracker

columns.name: era_product
columns.description: Era-Node (camera + processor module) or Era-Core (software only)

columns.name: altpnt_enabled
columns.description: Alternative navigation (works without GNSS) is turned on

columns.name: module_size_u
columns.description: Era-Node module volume in U (1U = 10 cm cube); null for software only

columns.name: data_start_date
columns.description: First day in this data: later of commissioning and contract start

tables.name: dim_rso
tables.description: Resident space object catalog: tracked objects in orbit (payloads, rocket bodies, debris).

columns.name: first_cataloged
columns.description: Date the object entered the public catalog

columns.name: is_fragment
columns.description: Fragment from a known breakup event

columns.name: parent_event
columns.description: Breakup event the fragment came from

tables.name: fct_detections
tables.description: Objects detected by onboard sensors and the onboard attempt to identify them against the onboard catalog.

columns.name: firmware_version
columns.description: Era-Core firmware running at detection time

columns.name: match_status
columns.description: matched (identified), unmatched (real object, not in onboard catalog) or false_alarm (no object)

columns.name: sun_angle_deg
columns.description: Angle between sensor boresight and the Sun, degrees

columns.name: onboard_latency_ms
columns.description: Time from image to identification, ms

tables.name: fct_conjunctions
tables.description: Close approaches screened for each spacecraft and the decision taken.
tables.grain: One row per screening message (see caveats on repeats)

columns.name: source
columns.description: onboard (own screening) or ground_cdm (ground conjunction data message)

columns.name: decision_mode
columns.description: autonomous (onboard) or ground; null for low risk

columns.name: decision_latency_min
columns.description: Minutes from screening to decision; null for low risk

tables.name: fct_nav_daily
tables.grain: One row per spacecraft per day

columns.name: gnss_available_pct
columns.description: Share of the day with a GNSS fix

columns.name: pos_error_p50_m
columns.description: Median position error vs. post-processed truth, m

columns.name: uptime_pct
columns.description: Share of the day in nominal mode (not safe mode)

tests.test: rso_id is set only when matched
detections on fragments before they were cataloged

metrics.name: detections
metrics.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orbit.fct_detections WHERE detected_at::DATE BETWEEN DATE '2026-10-05' AND DATE '2026-10-11'

metrics.name: catalog_match_rate
metrics.sql: SELECT AVG((match_status='matched')::INT) FROM orbit.fct_detections WHERE detected_at::DATE BETWEEN DATE '2026-10-05' AND DATE '2026-10-11'

metrics.name: false_alarm_rate
metrics.sql: SELECT AVG((match_status='false_alarm')::INT) FROM orbit.fct_detections WHERE detected_at::DATE BETWEEN DATE '2026-10-05' AND DATE '2026-10-11'

metrics.name: conjunctions
metrics.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT conjunction_id) FROM orbit.fct_conjunctions WHERE screened_at::DATE BETWEEN DATE '2026-10-05' AND DATE '2026-10-11'

metrics.name: autonomous_decision_share
metrics.description: Autonomous decisions / medium and high risk conjunctions (repeats removed).
metrics.sql: SELECT AVG((decision_mode='autonomous')::INT) FROM (SELECT * FROM orbit.fct_conjunctions QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY conjunction_id ORDER BY screened_at)=1) WHERE risk_tier<>'low' AND screened_at::DATE BETWEEN DATE '2026-10-05' AND DATE '2026-10-11'

metrics.name: delta_v_mps
metrics.sql: SELECT SUM(executed_dv_mps) FROM orbit.fct_maneuvers WHERE executed_at::DATE BETWEEN DATE '2026-01-01' AND DATE '2026-10-11'

metrics.name: nav_error_p95_m
metrics.description: Mean of daily p95 position error across spacecraft-days, m.
metrics.sql: SELECT AVG(pos_error_p95_m) FROM orbit.fct_nav_daily WHERE nav_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-10-05' AND DATE '2026-10-11'

caveats: Fully synthetic. Modeled on what spacecraft autonomy companies describe in public; customers, spacecraft and objects are invented.
fct_conjunctions has repeated rows: the ground CDM feed resends messages. Count DISTINCT conjunction_id, or keep the first row per conjunction_id.
unmatched is not a false alarm: unmatched is a real object that is not in the onboard catalog; false_alarm has no object behind it.
The onboard catalog is uploaded weekly, so objects new to the public catalog show as unmatched for about a week.
Spacecraft enter the data at data_start_date (later of commissioning and contract start), so the fleet grows over time. Normalize counts per spacecraft-day before comparing periods.
nav_error_p95_m is the mean of daily per-spacecraft p95 values, not a fleet-wide p95.
Firmware is per detection and per day; rollouts are staged by customer, so versions overlap for days.
questions: Why did the false alarm rate rise in the week of Oct 5, 2026?
Why did conjunctions and delta-v jump in late August 2026?
Does alt-PNT keep navigation error down during GNSS jamming? Compare missions.
How much faster are autonomous avoidance decisions than ground decisions?
Which firmware version has the best catalog match rate, by sensor?
